---
title: "HTTP API reference"
description: "Create scans, authorize browser capture, and retrieve results from your backend."
---

Use the Bouncr HTTP API from your backend to create scans in a venue, authorize a capture session, and retrieve results. Requests use `https://api.bouncr.io` with a scoped bearer credential.

<Info>
  Keep your organization credential on your backend. Pass the scan’s initialization token and configuration through your existing onboarding response or page props.
</Info>

## Authentication

Send your credential in the `Authorization` header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
```

The endpoint reference lists its required scope. A scope grants an operation; your credential's organization and venue access determine which records it can act on. The same credential can serve multiple authorized venues. Resolve each scan’s venue from your backend application record, as shown in [Connect your backend](/external/backend).

| Task | Scope |
| --- | --- |
| Create scans | `scans:create` |
| Authorize capture | `scans:capture` |
| Read scan status | `scans:read` |
| Read verification results | `scans:results:read` |
| List scans | `scans:list` |

## Response handling

Treat scan and venue IDs as strings. Error responses use HTTP status codes; your client should handle empty response bodies before attempting to parse JSON.
